title: Heir Hunting Operator Companion Workbook
subtitle: 6 Field Worksheets, Deal Qualification Matrices & 30-Day Execution Logs

worksheets.title: Case Intake and Jurisdiction Matrix
worksheets.purpose: Turn an official lead into a traceable accept, hold, or close decision without conflating probate and custodial recovery rules.
instructions: Open one record per deduplicated lead; use a case ID rather than personal identifiers in filenames.
Capture the official source before interpreting it, and mark unavailable facts unknown rather than estimating silently.
Complete all four screening tests with evidence references; any unresolved test remains a hold.
Record the next bounded inquiry or closure reason and include closed leads in cohort totals.

fields.guidance: Use a unique ID, intake date, researcher, and monthly cohort; link duplicates to the original.
Name the controlling jurisdiction and whether this is probate or a specific custodial process.
Enter docket or property ID, custodian, URL, retrieval date, source-image reference, and current status.
Pass / Hold / Fail; cite current availability evidence and distinguish listing value from distributable value.
Pass / Hold / Fail; cite counsel's PI, UPL, fee, timing, and deadline findings with review date.
Pass / Hold / Fail; list identity anchors, missing relationships, and accessible proof sources.
Pass / Hold / Fail; record fee assumptions, remaining costs, uncertainty, and spending ceiling.
Accept, hold, or close; record dead-lead reason, owner, next date, and permitted next expense.

completion_checklist: Official source and current custodian recorded.
All four tests have dispositions and supporting references.
Unknowns remain explicit; no name-only identity acceptance.
Closure or follow-up has an owner and date.

worksheets.title: Kinship Proof and Conflict Register
worksheets.purpose: Make every claimed relationship reproducible through a GPS evidence trail and an independent review record.
instructions: Create one relationship entry per parent-child or other necessary identity link; do not rely on an unlabeled family tree.
Attach source citations and image locators, then distinguish what the record says from the conclusion you draw.
Log negative searches and conflicts before drafting the written proof argument.
Send the versioned packet to a reviewer who did not author it and retain corrections.

fields.guidance: Link each relationship to the case ID and a specific proof question.
Record names, variants, dates, places, and distinguishing facts; restrict full identifiers to the vault.
For each source ID record repository, collection, volume/page or image, record date, access date, and locator.
Separate original or derivative source quality, informant knowledge, and direct or indirect support.
Enter index, jurisdiction, date range, variants searched, result, and limitations of coverage.
Quote conflicting facts, explain their weight, and identify the next record required if unresolved.
Correlate the sources and explain the relationship conclusion; identify unresolved hypotheses explicitly.
Record reviewer, date, packet version, pass/correct/hold, objections, and evidence of correction.

completion_checklist: Every necessary relationship has source-backed reasoning.
Search coverage and unresolved conflicts are visible.
Citations resolve to retrievable records.
Independent reviewer disposition matches the current packet version.

worksheets.title: Distribution Shares and Cohort Economics
worksheets.purpose: Separate the claimant's provisional distribution from the firm's contingent fee and actual collected contribution.
instructions: Have counsel identify the governing distribution rule before using a per-stirpes illustration.
List all eligible branches, fractions, and unresolved persons; reconcile fractions to one before applying a distributable pool.
Calculate fees only from the applicable lawful compensation basis; never book an estate's face value as firm revenue.
Maintain both cash costs and owner-time economics, including zero collections and failed cases.

fields.guidance: Record jurisdiction, statute, counsel review, spouse assumptions, representation method, and unresolved issues.
Show asset amount less debts, expenses, priority claims, and reserves; mark unknown deductions.
For each branch list person ID, relationship, survival facts, fraction, amount, and supporting proof IDs.
State permissible base, rate or amount, timing restrictions, contract reference, and maximum collectible fee assumption.
Itemize record fees, research hours and rates, QC, counsel, travel, and remaining commitments.
Record actual receipts less refunds and direct costs; keep signed contingent amounts in a separate column.
State allocation method, owner hours, imputed wage, and whether reported owner net includes owner compensation.
Sum paid cash and unavoidable commitments at zero receipts; show unpaid owner-time cost separately.
Include failed files, collection timing, budget remaining, and continue/narrow/close rationale.

completion_checklist: Distribution fractions and amounts reconcile under explicit assumptions.
Claimant distribution, signed fees, and cash receipts are separate.
Failed-file costs and owner hours are included.
Next spending decision fits the approved cash ceiling.

worksheets.title: Verified Outreach and Contract Review Log
worksheets.purpose: Connect reviewed evidence to accurate, minimal-disclosure communication and a lane-specific engagement record.
instructions: Confirm proof review and permitted contact scope before using live recipient details.
Use a versioned message that identifies the firm accurately and avoids award promises or government affiliation claims.
Record counsel's review of the actual proposed agreement, not a generic template approval.
If live contact cannot proceed, record a fictional dry-run and the specific unresolved condition.

fields.guidance: Enter case ID, proof version, independent reviewer disposition, and unresolved limitations.
Cite identity matching and address or channel verification without duplicating sensitive documents.
Record jurisdiction, authorized sender, applicable restrictions, and counsel's specific conclusions.
Link the approved script; mark live or fictional dry-run and explain any dry-run condition.
Record scope, fee base and cap, timing, cancellation terms where required, legal-service boundary, and reviewer date.
Record date, channel, sender, version, response, and any request to stop contact.
Specify minimum documents, recipient verification, secure channel, and access expiry.
Name owner and date; distinguish factual follow-up from questions reserved for counsel.

completion_checklist: Recipient and contact channel are supported by records.
Current message and agreement reviews are linked.
No unrelated identity documents are included.
Responses, stop requests, or dry-run limitations are recorded.

worksheets.title: Case Operations, Access, and Quality Board
worksheets.purpose: Keep a small team within real capacity while preserving independent review and task-scoped access.
instructions: Assign the five operating responsibilities even where one person holds several roles.
Calculate protected research hours and downstream review capacity before opening deep-work slots.
Record handoffs with source-linked deliverables, next dates, and reviewer dispositions.
Review access when assignments change and close both the case and its outstanding supplier commitments.

fields.guidance: Name principal, genealogist, independent reviewer, coordinator, and independent outside probate counsel.
Show protected hours / weekly dossier demand; 40 / 10 = four concurrent deep files before buffer.
Record state, entry date, active hours, external dependency, next date, and owner.
Link the actual relationship assessment, applicable rules, adviser, date, and changed working conditions.
List individual account, assigned case, role, permitted records, grant date, and expiry.
Track packet version, independent disposition, blocking evidence defects, corrections, and re-review.
Record restoration test result, record-specific retention schedule, and dispute exceptions.
Reconcile costs, revoke access, resolve commitments, preserve required evidence, and record closure reason.

completion_checklist: No author independently reviews their own packet.
Starts fit research and downstream review capacity.
Waiting cases have owners and follow-up dates.
Access, costs, and supplier commitments reconcile at closure.

worksheets.title: Thirty-Day Pilot Execution and Decision Log
worksheets.purpose: Produce a dated record of the pilot, its real downside, and the Day-30 continuation decision.
instructions: Enter one daily row with planned action, actual action, evidence link, hours, cash spent, owner, and next step.
Close each weekly block against its deliverables rather than marking activity alone as success.
Reconcile all twenty leads and distinguish live outreach from a fictional rehearsal.
Complete a signed Continue / Revise / Stop memo even if no fees have been collected.

fields.guidance: Record state, lane, start date, cash ceiling, hours, reviewer, counsel contact, and stop conditions.
Days 1–30: plan, actual work, artifact ID, owner, hours, spend, blocker, and next action.
Link scope memo, PI/UPL/fee analysis, encrypted-vault access test, restore result, and budget.
List twenty deduplicated official records; reconcile pass, hold, and closed totals with dead-lead reasons.
Link GPS packets, provisional per-stirpes tables, independent QC dispositions, and unresolved legal questions.
Link verified outreach or dry-run logs, agreement review, cost ledger, and decision memo.
Show receipts, paid costs, outstanding commitments, unpaid owner hours, remaining cash, and budget variance.
Continue with a usable reviewed route and funded capacity; Revise with a bounded repair; Stop if authority, proof, or loss budget fails.
Record decision owner, date, rationale, scope, maximum spend, repair owner, deadline, and next review date.

completion_checklist: All four weekly blocks link to actual artifacts or explicit missing items.
Twenty lead dispositions reconcile without duplicates.
Live contact and dry-run activity are clearly distinguished.
Zero collections remain visible in the downside calculation.
Day-30 decision has a rationale, owner, date, and bounded next step.
